tasks.label: Run Packaged Workbench (Launch.exe)
tasks.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "if (Test-Path '${workspaceFolder}/Launch.exe') { Start-Process '${workspaceFolder}/Launch.exe' } elseif (Test-Path '${workspaceFolder}/dist/UnifiedEngineeringWorkbench/Launch.exe') { Start-Process '${workspaceFolder}/dist/UnifiedEngineeringWorkbench/Launch.exe' } else { Write-Error 'Launch.exe not found. Run Package task first.' }"
tasks.detail: Launches the packaged standalone Launch.exe in extracted archive or dist root without requiring C++ debugging extensions

tasks.label: Run Packaged WorkbenchApp (Direct)
tasks.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "if (Test-Path '${workspaceFolder}/bin/WorkbenchApp.exe') { Start-Process '${workspaceFolder}/bin/WorkbenchApp.exe' -WorkingDirectory '${workspaceFolder}' } elseif (Test-Path '${workspaceFolder}/dist/UnifiedEngineeringWorkbench/bin/WorkbenchApp.exe') { Start-Process '${workspaceFolder}/dist/UnifiedEngineeringWorkbench/bin/WorkbenchApp.exe' -WorkingDirectory '${workspaceFolder}/dist/UnifiedEngineeringWorkbench' } else { Write-Error 'WorkbenchApp.exe not found. Build first.' }"
tasks.detail: Runs the packaged Qt application directly with proper working directory
